subject: FinApps Dedicated onboarding — GPU pool, autoscale & kickoff coordination
body:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Johnson <sara@finapps.com>, Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@finapps.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff — FinApps Dedicated onboarding (GPU pool + next steps)

Hi team,

Looping Marissa and the CSM/implementation crew in to kick off dedicated capacity onboarding for FinApps (RDW-53421). Quick summary:
- Customer: FinApps (B2B SaaS, data platform for financial advisors)
- Committed: reserved capacity (monthly) + small burst allowance during market open hours
- Initial ask: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west with autoscale to 12 for bursts; expected 150 concurrent short (1–3s) generation calls at peak.
- Security: need VPC peering, audit logs, and KMS integration. SOC2 docs requested (attached).

Attachments: FinApps-deal-summary.pdf (PDF, 85KB) — includes signed SOW and technical notes.

Sara/Sales: please confirm the expected model families (e.g., 7B vs 70B) and the preferred kick-off window.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: Sara Johnson <sara@finapps.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@finapps.com>, it@finapps.com <it@finapps.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff — FinApps Dedicated onboarding (GPU pool + next steps)

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the handoff. A few clarifications from our side:
- Region: we prefer us-west to keep latency low for our west-coast customers.
- Models: primarily 13B and 70B variants for different features (13B for chat/low-cost tasks, 70B for high-quality summarization).
- Concurrency: the 150 concurrent figure is a rough peak — many calls will be short, but we've seen spikes during market open.
- Autoscale/burst: we want autoscale that ramps quickly at market open; bursting to 12 GPUs for 30–60 minutes is acceptable. Please share expected cost delta for the burst window and any hard caps we can set.

Available for a kickoff next week (Mar 9–11). Can you provide a mutual action plan and an initial capacity recommendation? Also: who will be our primary technical contact for provisioning and VPC peering?

Sara Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FinApps

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnson <sara@finapps.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff — FinApps Dedicated onboarding (GPU pool + next steps)

Hi Sara — copying tech notes inline.

Short answers:
- Region: us-west is fine; we'll provision in the customer-preferred AZs.
- GPU type: recommended starting point is 8x A100-80GB equivalent (balanced for 13B/70B) — gives headroom for batching and KV cache.
- Autoscaling: we typically recommend target-based scaling on 90th pct CPU/GPU utilization with a fast scale-up policy (1–2 minute scale-up) and a gentler scale-down (5–10 minutes) to avoid flapping. Burst to 12 GPUs for 30–60 minutes is implemented as a scheduled policy or traffic-triggered policy.
- Cost delta: burst GPUs billed at same rate as reserved but multiplied by burst hours; estimate: ~20–25% increase in monthly spend if bursts happen for ~1 hour/day over market days. I can provide a more precise model if you share expected daily burst minutes.

Questions for you:
1) Can you share the model artifact sizes (13B and 70B) or the flank quantization you expect? This affects NVMe and memory planning.
2) Any requirements for pinned model versions (do you expect frequent model swaps)?
3) Access: we will need a service account + a CIDR block for allowlisting for the initial handshake.

I'll draft an initial capacity plan and share an XLS with a couple of scenarios.

—Vivek
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnson <sara@finapps.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@finapps.com>, it@finapps.com <it@finapps.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff — FinApps Dedicated onboarding (GPU pool + next steps)

Hi Sara / team — thanks for the quick answers. I've attached a short mutual action plan (FinApps-MAP-v1.pdf) and an initial capacity workbook (FinApps-capacity-plan.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff call — Tue Mar 10, 10:00 PT (60 min). Agenda: scope review, provisioning window, VPC peering checklist, autoscale policy decisions, security docs and next steps. Please confirm availability.
2) Technical intake — Vivek to run a short sizing questionnaire and collect model artifacts (ideally a sample token profile + model weight sizes).
3) Provisioning window — we recommend a 2–4 hour window during a non-peak day for initial pool provisioning + smoke tests.
4) Validation — we will run load tests and verify autoscale behavior; plan for a staged rollout (canary + full).

Access/contacts needed from FinApps:
- Primary network contact (for VPC peering/allowlist)
- Service account for API keys
- Expected daily peak minutes for burst planning

I also noted a couple of potential constraints: if FinApps wants strict on-prem KMS integration we may need an extra ops step — Rafael, can you confirm whether the SOW included KMS in scope?

Attachments: FinApps-MAP-v1.pdf, FinApps-capacity-plan.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff — FinApps Dedicated onboarding (GPU pool + next steps)

Marissa — quick ask before you send the kickoff invite to FinApps: please include a one-paragraph SLA/uptime note and our escalation contacts (on-call + AM) in the MAP. Also flag that the initial burst policy is time-limited and that any sustained burst will require a revision to the reserved commit.

Make sure the MAP includes a short rollback plan for canary failures and a named Ops contact for the provisioning window.

Thanks — Laura
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnson <sara@finapps.com>, Mark O'Neill <mark.oneill@finapps.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff — FinApps Dedicated onboarding (GPU pool + next steps)

Sara / Mark — thanks for confirming region and model families. Confirming the kickoff for Tue Mar 10, 10:00 PT (I’ll send a calendar invite). Attached: FinApps-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones), FinApps-capacity-plan.xlsx (3 scenarios: conservative 6 GPUs, baseline 8 GPUs, aggressive 12 GPUs with burst).

Claire items / immediate asks for FinApps:
- Please share a network contact and a CIDR for allowlisting before Mar 6.
- Provide model artifact sizes or approximate weight sizes so Vivek can finalize the NVMe + memory plan.
- Confirm whether KMS integration is required (yes/no).

What we’ll do before kickoff:
- Vivek will publish a short sizing questionnaire and a recommended autoscale policy (I’ve included his rough defaults in the MAP).
- Rafael will confirm KMS scope from the SOW.
- I’ll include SLA blurb and escalation contacts (Ops on-call / AM) in the MAP per Laura’s note.

Attachments (for reference):
- FinApps-MAP-v1.pdf — Mutual Action Plan (timeline, owners, acceptance criteria)
- FinApps-capacity-plan.xlsx — Scenario workbook (resource/cost breakdown)
- FinApps-deal-summary.pdf — Signed SOW (from Rafael)

Next steps: I’ll send the calendar invite and an agenda. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

[Attachment stubs: FinApps-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF), FinApps-capacity-plan.xlsx (Excel), FinApps-deal-summary.pdf (PDF)]
